data.name: Ghamid
data.gender_notes: Ghamid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: He who is heavy or carrying a load
data.long_meaning: In Islamic traditions, the name Ghamid is derived from the Arabic root 'ghamada' which means 'to carry a heavy load' or 'to be burdened'. This name is often given to a child born into a family with numerous siblings or to one who is expected to carry the responsibility of a large family or community. The name is also associated with the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who is known to have carried the burden of the Ummah (Muslim community) and guided them towards righteousness.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the weight of responsibilities and guiding others towards righteousness
data.etymology: Ghamid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “He who is heavy or carrying a load.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghamid total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
